_comment: Iran not among AC's three named retail launches (Bahamas, Jamaica, Nigeria). China: e-CNY is a live national retail program — launched; some trackers still say pilot (labeling only).

countries.description: Largest live retail CBDC program worldwide: hundreds of millions of users and very large transaction volumes (PBOC figures). Some trackers still call it a pilot; domestically it operates as a production retail system tied to surveillance and the social credit system.
